scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w @chame/api" "npm run dev -w @chame/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chame/shared && npm run generate -w @chame/api && npm run build -w @chame/api && npm run build -w @chame/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @chame/shared && npm run generate -w @chame/api && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @chame/shared && npm run test -w @chame/api
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/api/src apps/web/src packages/shared/src apps/api/scripts apps/api/test scripts *.md *.json .github infrastructure --ignore-path .gitignore
